flags: 'Kgetha' is the Northern Sotho/Setswana-style spelling; Lesotho/most Sesotho text uses 'Khetha' (minor, orthographic; SA Sesotho does use kg- in some words)

back: List of crops (lit. 'list of the plantings/crops')
flags: 'Lenane' = list/menu; as a group heading it reads as 'list of crops' rather than 'Crops' - a bit wordy but understandable
'dinate' is not a word I can confirm for 'nuts' in Sesotho; could be read as something else (uncertain)
'tsa tlhaho' = 'of nature/natural'; reasonable for wild fruit

back: Other plants of the 'forest of food' (other food-forest plants)
flags: 'sekgwa sa dijo' is a calque 'food forest'; 'Dimela' = plants; meaning of 'sekgwa' (woodland/bush) for a farmer is unclear and heading is cryptic; cannot tell what category it denotes
'se seng' = 'another/a different'; does not convey 'one not in the list' strongly but acceptable

back: Write the name of the product
Save the product (lit. keep/store the product)
Money of the hands / hand money (cash in hand)
flags: 'ya matsoho' = 'of the hands' - literal idiom for 'cash (in hand)'; after 'Invoice ·' it can read as a cash-on-hand balance rather than a payment method; understandable but not fully idiomatic
Loanword 'karete'; bare 'card' with no 'bank'/'pay' context - could be read as any card (e.g. ID card, playing card)
'Fono' means only the telephone device; does NOT read as a payment method after 'Invoice ·' - ambiguous, could mean 'phoned' or 'by telephone'; no mobile-money meaning
